newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil re-election bill goes to Chamber today.
newsitem.headline: Brazil re-election bill goes to Chamber today.

text.p: A bill allowing President Fernando Henrique Cardoso to seek re-election will be presented to the Chamber of Deputies at 1600 local/1800 GMT, Congress officials said.
Government leaders have said that if enough deputies turn up and they believe they have the necessary support, they may push for a vote tonight.
Newspapers reported Tuesday that Cardoso allies claimed they had at least 330 votes, surpassing the 308 votes necessary to win.
As a constitutional amendment, the bill must be approved by 60 percent of deputies and senators in two rounds of voting in both the lower and upper houses.
